name: Ariel
source:
Minami was like every other girl: talkative, attractive and sensitive, also loves the beach---Not until she loses her father, then everything in her life has changed.

This is not a sad, tragic mermaid story; This is just another corny, cheesy story of an ordinary girl who is a little obsessed with her childhood best friend.

[From [url=https://daruku-darc.itch.io/ariel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
小南和其他女孩一样：健谈、有吸引力、敏感，也热爱海滩——直到她失去了父亲，她生活中的一切都改变了。

这不是一个悲伤、悲惨的美人鱼故事；而是一个故事。这只是另一个老套、俗气的故事，讲述的是一个普通女孩对她儿时最好的朋友有点迷恋的故事。

[来自[url=https://daruku-darc.itch.io/ariel]itch.io[/url]]
